# Startup Garage

> Startup Garage is Uzbekistan's startup accelerator and community (10 years, 550+ portfolio residents). It supports founders from idea to market entry with mentorship, education, networking and help raising investment.

Languages: Uzbek (default, /uz/) and English (/en/).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://startupgarage.uz/en/): programs, results, how Startup Garage helps
- [Services](https://startupgarage.uz/en/services/): programs and support for startups
- [Portfolio](https://startupgarage.uz/en/portfolio/): resident startups and investment wins
- [Grand Demo Day](https://startupgarage.uz/en/grand-demo-day/): annual demo day for resident startups
- [Events](https://startupgarage.uz/en/events/): upcoming and past events
- [Team](https://startupgarage.uz/en/team/): founders and core team
- [Branches](https://startupgarage.uz/en/branches/): regional branches
- [SG Women](https://startupgarage.uz/en/sg-women/): program for women founders
- [For partners](https://startupgarage.uz/en/for-partners/): partnership options
- [Books](https://startupgarage.uz/en/books/): recommended and published books
- [Media](https://startupgarage.uz/en/media/): press and media coverage
- [Blog](https://startupgarage.uz/en/blog/): articles for founders

## Apply
- [Resident application](https://resident.startupgarage.uz): submit a startup application
